create_scheduler_loader: create a SchedulerLoader instance to load a diffusers scheduler from a model path
load_scheduler_from_path: load a scheduler from a diffusers component config using SchedulerLoader.load_customized
resolve_scheduler_class: resolve a scheduler class name via ModelRegistry.resolve_model_cls from diffusers config
set_scheduler_shift: set a flow shift value on a loaded scheduler via scheduler.set_shift
get_diffusers_component_config: get diffusers component config from a model path using get_diffusers_component_config
